LESSON: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Fruit of the Holy Spirit
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Today’s focus: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
